name: Smart Search's Advanced Search page follows the dashboard theme through the kit's tokens: as viewer, a title search ('test', Movies) in Dark, Light, Apple TV and Purple Haze (localStorage '<userId>-appTheme', then a reload; Dark is a fresh profile's theme): the page's text is the theme's text colour, and the pressed item type and the Search button are the theme's accent. Screenshots smartsearch-search-theme-*.png.

steps.name: page helpers
steps.initScript:
window.__ss = {
  root: () => [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-jfss-page="search"][data-jfss-mounted] .jfss-search')].find(x => x.getClientRects().length > 0) || null,
  q: (s) => { const r = window.__ss.root(); return r ? r.querySelector(s) : null; },
  all: (s) => { const r = window.__ss.root(); return r ? [...r.querySelectorAll(s)] : []; },
  set: (s, v) => { const e = window.__ss.q(s); e.value = v; e.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); e.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; },
  ready: () => !!window.__ss.q('.jfss-scope') && !!window.__ss.q('.jfss-search-button'),
  done: () => { const c = window.__ss.q('.jfss-count'); const n = window.__ss.q('.jfss-notices'); if (c && c.textContent && !/Searching/.test(c.textContent)) return c.textContent; if (n && n.textContent) return n.textContent; return false; },
  ids: () => window.__ss.all('.jfss-card, .jfss-row').map(x => x.getAttribute('data-id')),
  names: () => window.__ss.all('.jfss-card, .jfss-row').map(x => (x.querySelector('bdi') || x).textContent.trim()),
  pressed: (s) => window.__ss.all(s).filter(b => b.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'true').map(b => b.textContent),
  norm: (ids) => ids.map(i => String(i).replace(/-/g, '').toLowerCase()).sort().join(),
  server: async (q) => window.__ss.norm((await ApiClient.getItems(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), Object.assign({ Recursive: true }, q))).Items.map(i => i.Id)),
  noHScroll: () => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth && window.__ss.root().scrollWidth <= window.__ss.root().clientWidth + 1,
  box: (e) => { const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return [Math.round(r.width), Math.round(r.height)]; }
};

steps.name: the page is on its route before the reload (a goto within the page returns before the browser has the new address, and a reload at once would load the old one)
the colours (Dark)
steps.eval: (() => { const host = document.querySelector('[data-jfss-page="search"][data-jfss-mounted]'); const kind = __ss.all('.jfss-kind').find(b => b.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'true'); return { pageColor: getComputedStyle(host).color, htmlColor: getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).color, kindBackground: getComputedStyle(kind).backgroundColor, searchBackground: getComputedStyle(__ss.q('.jfss-search-button')).backgroundColor, titleColor: getComputedStyle(__ss.q('.jfss-title')).color }; })()
